summary: Rivet exposes an OAuth-protected MCP server for AI clients to inspect actors, call actions, and use the Actor Inspector.

rivet_oauth.label: Rivet OAuth access
rivet_oauth.setup: Connect your MCP client to https://mcp.rivet.dev/mcp and complete the Rivet sign-in and consent flow. The client discovers the authorization server through OAuth protected resource metadata and sends the access token as an Authorization bearer token.
